prompt: No model and no prompt: made in code from the committed hand-drawn v2 pixel map (assets/source/sprites/shots/missile.v2.sprite.json, w15-PIXMAP1). The interim map was a stretched v1 box, not a redraw, and FLUX never drew this lance-subject cleanly (the s-shots-missile asks); the map is the last name in the v2 interim pool. The redraw is hand-pixelled per art bible v2 § 5.3 — the missile at 12 × 5 with tail fins on the outline rows, a two-pixel nozzle, a three-step tapered exhaust flame and a white nose shoulder capped in outline dark — on v1's exact five colours; this script lays those map rows ×16 nearest on the flat ask key, one solid block per pixel, centred in each cell of the sheet.
origin: derived in code from the committed v2 pixel map: no AI model, no GPU, no server
label: MISSILE v2 animation sheet, two frames (v2: 2 flicker frames 12x5)

transform.layout: one row of two cells, read left to right; one continuous key
transform.key: RGB 81,224,24 (the ask key #51e018); every non-subject pixel is exactly this
transform.design: the rows and the five colours are READ from the committed map at run time — the map is the design source of truth (palette #2a3a4a outline, #a0a8b8 body, #ffffff nose shoulder, #e84818 ember, #f8c030 flame core)
transform.geometry: alpha and pixel positions byte-identical to the map rows (opaque per frame 52/52)
transform.upscale: nearest x16 onto the key, each frame centred in its cell (the subject box is exactly 192x80)

pins.targetGrid: shots/missile 2f 12×5 a6,2 (the ground missile, fly [0,1], hitFlash false, no @flash or @palette sibling — the palette law covers bullets/ and lasers/ only)
pins.sheetContract: key RGB 81,224,24; 1×2 cells 384×256 read row-major; crop boxes [96,88,192,80] [480,88,192,80] (exact upscaled subject boxes, gutters ≥ 96 px of flat key)
pins.rowCite: mission brief w15-PIXMAP1 (era-final interim census: shots/missile 118→…→1→0)
pins.sourceWinners: assets/source/sprites/shots/missile.v2.sprite.json — the committed hand-drawn v2 map (R4-01.A6 grid, w15-PIXMAP1 redraw); the script reads its rows directly
